info.name: Gladia Control AudioToText Live V2 API

description.content: Gladia AI audio infrastructure API for speech-to-text transcription via REST and WebSocket. Supports asynchronous pre-recorded audio processing and real-time live transcription with speaker diarization, automatic language detection across 100+ languages, and audio intelligence features.
